features.text: Advanced 4:1 SlickTrack system provides precise compression control for post-surgical recovery and disc-related conditions
Independent upper and lower adjustment panels deliver targeted support for specific vertebral levels during rehabilitation
Integrated vertical stays ensure consistent spinal alignment while managing compression fractures and disc injuries
Professional-grade tri-band technology maintains therapeutic compression levels for extended recovery periods

measurement: For optimal spinal support, measure your waist circumference at navel level. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for expert sizing assistance and a guaranteed perfect fit.
